setting.name: *ghostalpha
setting.desc: Set to true to make vehicle semi-transparent when collisions are disabled.

setting.name: *ghostalphalevel
setting.desc: Amount of transparency when collisions are disabled. Acceptable values are from 0 (fully transparent) to 255 (fully opaque).

setting.name: *ghostmode
setting.desc: Set to true to disable collisions.

setting.name: *ghostmode_map_can_override
setting.desc: Set to true to allow the map to override this setting.

setting.name: *ghostmode_warning_if_map_override
setting.desc: Set to true to issue a warning to players in the chatbox, if the map overrides this setting.

setting.name: *anyonecanspec
setting.desc: Allow any player to start spectating with the 'B' key. (Does not work in no repawn maps)

setting.name: *endmapwhenonlyspectators
setting.friendlyname: End map when only spectators left
setting.desc: Set to true to end the map when only spectators are left

setting.name: *endmapwhenserverempty
setting.friendlyname: End map when there are no players on the server
setting.desc: Set to true to end the map when there are no players on the server

setting.name: *joinspectating
setting.desc: Set to true to make joining players spectate the race in progress.

setting.name: *norsadminspectate
setting.desc: Allow admins to spectate while alive in no respawn maps.

setting.name: *racerespawn
setting.desc: Force players to spawn like after death.

setting.name: *stealthspectate
setting.desc: Set to true to hide the state of spectating admins.

setting.name: *blur
setting.desc: Set to 0 to turn off blur.

setting.name: *clouds
setting.desc: Set to false to turn off clouds.

setting.name: *color
setting.desc: Color of the Race chat box messages.

setting.name: *countdowneffect
setting.desc: Set to true for a fancy effect on the last countdown image.

setting.name: *thirdcpblipalphalevel
setting.desc: Amount of transparency of the third checkpoint blip displayed on the radar / minimap. Acceptable values are from 0 (fully transparent) to 255 (fully opaque).

setting.name: *autopimp
setting.desc: Set to true to apply a selection of visual upgrades to vehicles.

setting.name: *autopimp_map_can_override
setting.desc: Set to true to allow the map to override this setting.

setting.name: *firewater
setting.desc: Set to true to explode the player when entering the water.

setting.name: *firewater_map_can_override
setting.desc: Set to true to allow the map to override this setting.

setting.name: *skins
setting.desc: Choose a driver skin. Acceptable values can be 'cj' or 'random' or a range list like this:'7 10 16-20 15'

setting.name: *randomclothes
setting.desc: Set to true to enable random clothes for CJ

setting.name: *skins_map_can_override
setting.desc: Set to true to allow the map to override this setting.

setting.name: *vehiclecolors
setting.desc: Set to file to use the server file: mods\deathmatch\vehiclecolors.conf

setting.name: *hunterminigun
setting.desc: Set to true to allow the Hunter minigun.

setting.name: *hunterminigun_map_can_override
setting.desc: Set to true to allow the map to override this setting.

setting.name: *vehicleweapons
setting.desc: Set to true to allow vehicle weapons.

setting.name: *vehicleweapons_map_can_override
setting.desc: Set to true to allow the map to override this setting.

setting.name: *vehicleweapons_warning_if_map_override
setting.desc: Set to true to issue a warning to players in the chatbox, if the map overrides this setting.

setting.name: *countdownduration
setting.desc: Default value to start the pre-race countdown timer at. Ticks of 4 and greater are silent and invisible.

setting.name: *postfinishcountdownduration
setting.desc: Number of seconds before the next map or vote for the next map starts after a race finishes.

setting.name: *duration
setting.desc: Default duration in seconds, if one is not set in the map.

setting.name: *hurrytime
setting.desc: Display HURRY! message this many seconds before the time runs out.

setting.name: *joinrandomvote
setting.desc: If someone joins a lone player, start a vote to change to a random map.

setting.name: *percentagetimeafterfirstfinish
setting.desc: After someone wins, set time remaining to this % of 1st place racer's time. Set to 0 to use timeafterfirstfinish setting instead.

setting.name: *randommaps
setting.desc: Set to true to make the next map selection automatic.

setting.name: *respawnmode
setting.desc: Default respawn mode, if one is not set in the map.

setting.name: *respawntime
setting.desc: Default respawn time in seconds, if one is not set in the map.

setting.name: *timeafterfirstfinish
setting.desc: The number of seconds the race continues for after someone wins. Only used if percentagetimeafterfirstfinish is set to 0.

setting.name: *playagaincount
setting.desc: The number of times a map may be played again before the Play Again option is removed from the map vote. A play again count of 2 means 3 plays of the map total.

setting.name: *voteredo_raceleaderonly
setting.desc: Set to true to only make the race leader be able to start a redo vote until someone finishes.

setting.name: #addons
setting.desc: List of race addon resources to load automatically

setting.name: #statskey
setting.desc: To identify players for stats.

setting.name: *admingroup
setting.desc: To issue certain commands, the player must belong to one of the groups listed.

setting.name: *classicchangez
setting.desc: Set to true to move the player up when changing vehicles.

setting.name: *classicchangez_map_can_override
setting.desc: Set to true to allow the map to override this setting.

setting.name: *securitylevel
setting.desc: Detect fake packets. 0-No checks 1-Some checks 2-All checks.
